title: Lions put Isiah Pacheco on injured reserve

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Lions put Isiah Pacheco on injured reserve
sources.description: Lions head coach Dan Campbell said last week that he couldn't say anything "definitive" about running back Isiah Pacheco's status for Week 1, but the picture cleared up on Tuesday.
